Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation

Hi Connor / Marissa,

We're kicking off a security review for a potential integration with Redwood and our procurement team needs the SOC 2 Type II report and a short note on the covered audit period. Quick context: we plan to go live in January and need evidence before Dec 15 to hit our procurement calendar.

Could you share:
- The latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is OK) or a secure transfer option
- The audit period covered (start/end dates)
- A bridge letter template (if the report doesn't extend to our go-live date)

I've attached our security questionnaire (first tab is highest priority). Please let us know what you can provide and the expected turnaround.

Thanks,
Jayden Park
Security Programs Manager
Nimbus Analytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit window confirmation

Hi Jayden — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. Looping Marissa (security liaison) and Monica (customer success) so we can coordinate any follow-ups.

Short answers up-front to help your procurement calendar:
- Audit period for our most recent SOC 2 Type II: 2025-10-01 through 2026-09-30.
- We can provide a full Type II report via a secure, access-controlled link, or a redacted PDF if you prefer not to receive the full report.
- We also include an auditor-signed bridge letter when the audit period does not cover a customer's requested effective date; I've attached a bridge letter template we normally use.

What I'm attaching now (stubs):
- redwood_soc2_typeii_summary.pdf — short summary + control coverage map (sensitive; we will share full report via secure transfer)
- bridge_letter_template.docx — editable template we can adapt and have signed by our auditor if needed

Transfer options (pick one):
1) Encrypted SFTP drop — we'll provision a one-time encrypted SFTP and provide username/password + IP allowlist (recommended for procurement teams that want file traceability).
2) Pre-signed S3 link with limited time (48 hours) and ACL; we can require MFA on the receiving account.
3) Secure Box/SharePoint folder with access granted to named recipients.

Redaction policy: we can produce a vendor-facing redacted PDF removing auditor workpapers and any customer-identifying data. If your team needs a full, auditor-signed report, we require identity confirmation and a short DPA addendum (standard).

Next steps: let me know which transfer option you prefer and the name and email of the person who will download the file (we'll create an access record). If you need the bridge letter to cover a specific date range (for example, through 2027-01-01 for a Jan 1 go-live), please tell us the requested effective date and we'll route the bridge letter request to compliance/auditor.

We can typically provision an SFTP drop within 24 business hours once we have the recipient name and ID.

Best —
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
